ValidationRule.description: If an opportunity if modified, the closed date must be greater or equal than today
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT( $Setup.Application_Settings__c.Disable_Validation_Rules__c ), IsClosed = FALSE, CloseDate < TODAY (), NOT(RecordType.Name = "Cancellations"), $Profile.Name <> 'ALM - Custom: Fin/Ops/HR', $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'Custom: Fin/Ops/HR')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Close Date must be in the future
